CustomField.description: Forecast margin at completion across the contract's projects. Was (Revenue Recognized - Actual Cost) / Revenue Recognized, which swings wildly early in a contract because revenue is only recognized at milestone acceptance while cost accrues every month.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: (Revenue Allocation - Forecast Cost) / Revenue Allocation, summed across the contract's projects. Compare with Original Margin % to see erosion.
CustomField.label: Current Margin %
